uwp_capture_status: partial: original UWP app launched (Release, pid 34936, windowTitle 'MobileBroadband') and rendered its full dark-themed UI, but its CoreWindow exposed no child UIA elements to external automation (winapp ui inspect/search returned only a top-level Pane, 0 interactive elements). Title-driven navigation therefore could not switch scenarios, so only the initial frame (Scenario 1) is a true per-scenario golden; screenshots 02-07 are the same initial frame, not their own state.

features.name: Mobile Broadband Device
features.description: Shows current mobile broadband device + account information; account picker button 'Get Next Device Information'.
expected_behaviour: Page renders a device/account information panel with labeled fields (Account Provider Name, Network Account ID, Manufacturer, Model, etc.)
A 'No available accounts detected' button / account selector is visible
Content is visibly painted (dark theme, white text) matching the UWP sample

features.name: Network Account Watcher
features.description: Start/Stop a network account watcher and display device information events.
expected_behaviour: Start and Stop buttons are visible and enabled
Clicking Start begins watching and updates status text

features.name: Connection UI
features.description: Requests the system connection UI for the mobile broadband account.
expected_behaviour: A control to trigger the connection UI is visible
Invoking it attempts to show connection UI / status text

features.name: Get Connection Profiles
expected_behaviour: Invoking it lists available profiles or a status message

features.name: Modem information (New)
expected_behaviour: Invoking it populates modem info fields or a status message

features.name: Device Services (New)
expected_behaviour: Invoking it lists device services or a status message

features.name: SIM Card (New)
features.description: Reads SIM card information and ICCID record.
expected_behaviour: 'Get SIM Card Information' and 'Get Iccid Record Information' buttons are visible
Invoking 'Get SIM Card Information' populates SIM fields or a status message
'Get Iccid Record Information' becomes enabled/usable after SIM info is retrieved
